|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Imperial Decree (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-imperialdecree-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-imperialdecree022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialdecree.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialdecree.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Imperial Decree”. Text: “Deploy on table. Whenever you lose Force (except from Force drains, battle damage, or your card), may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Decree (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-imperialdecreeab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialdecree.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialdecree.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
